nodes.Name: BeliefKind
nodes.DocComment:
The belief store now lives in internal/belief so both the Understand track and
the Generate track can share it (presentation may not import internal/context,
and the generator may not import presentation, so a leaf package was required).
These aliases keep presentation's existing references (Belief, BeliefKind,
BeliefCorrection, BeliefLayer, …) working unchanged while the definitions live
in one place. Session 1 is a pure relocation — behavior is preserved.

nodes.DocComment:
SSEPublisher is the subset of sse.Broker that presentation.Server needs.
Accepting an interface avoids a circular import with the api/sse package.

nodes.Name: Server
nodes.DocComment: Server holds the dependencies for all presentation endpoints.

nodes.Name: StdlibRootView
nodes.DocComment: StdlibRootView is one root's outcome as rendered by the Understand UI.

nodes.Name: StdlibReportView

nodes.Name: SetStdlibReport
nodes.DocComment:
SetStdlibReport records the stdlib outcome for the Architecture page. Safe to
call before serving; guarded by the same lock as the rest of the hot-swappable
state so a dynamic project load can replace it.

nodes.Name: StdlibReport
nodes.DocComment: StdlibReport returns the recorded stdlib outcome.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment: New creates a presentation Server.

nodes.Name: BeliefStore
nodes.DocComment:
BeliefStore returns the live belief store so a GENERATION-SIDE caller can inject
the optional enrich tier (v26.22). presentation itself must never import
internal/enrich — it is a core Understand package and enrich pulls in the model
(archtest enforces this) — so the wiring is inverted: gen-server, which legitimately
links both halves, calls this and injects. understand-server simply never calls it,
and the enterprise binary stays model-free.

Returns nil before SetRoot has bound a project. Callers should re-inject after
SetRoot/ReplaceContext, since those rebind the store.

nodes.Name: SetRoot
nodes.DocComment:
(optionally) the copybook search path for on-demand COBOL parsing.
v20: called by gen-server after construction. Safe to pass "" for either.
v20.3: browseRoot widens the file browser's reach; pass "" to default it
to root.

nodes.Name: SetBroker
nodes.DocComment:
SetBroker wires an SSE publisher so OnFileChanged can push events to
connected Studio clients. Call once after construction, before Run.

nodes.Name: index
nodes.DocComment:
index returns the current symbol index under the read lock. v24: all handlers
read the index through this accessor so a live project swap (ReplaceContext)
is race-free. The returned pointer is a snapshot; callers must not retain it
across a lock boundary they don't hold.

nodes.Name: ReplaceContext
nodes.DocComment:
ReplaceContext atomically swaps the entire analysis context — symbol index,
CFGs, and effects — for a freshly loaded project. v24: this is the backend of
the Studio "load / clear project" (dynamic --root) feature. Everything is
swapped under the write lock so in-flight reads (via index() and the cfgs/efx
maps) see a consistent old-or-new snapshot, never a torn mix. Beliefs are
rebuilt from the new index (corrections are keyed by symbol and simply won't
match the new project's symbols — they are not lost, just inert until a
matching project is loaded again). Passing a nil idx clears the project
(empty state).

nodes.Name: OnFileChanged
nodes.DocComment:
OnFileChanged is the hook called by the file watcher after it has
updated the symbol index for path. It refreshes the Server's cached
CFGs/effects for the file, rebuilds the belief store, and pushes an
SSE "file_changed" event to all connected clients.

It must not block (called from the watcher goroutine).

nodes.Name: safeEfxCopy
nodes.DocComment: safeEfxCopy returns a read-safe snapshot of s.efx.

nodes.Name: AddFlowData
nodes.DocComment: AddFlowData provides flow analysis results (call after Build).

nodes.Name: RegisterRoutes
nodes.DocComment: RegisterRoutes wires all presentation endpoints into mux.

nodes.Name: isCobolPath
nodes.DocComment: isCobolPath reports whether path has a COBOL/copybook extension.

nodes.Name: fileEntry
nodes.DocComment: fileEntry is one item in a directory listing.

nodes.Name: handleFiles
nodes.DocComment:
handleFiles is a read-only directory browser rooted at s.root. It powers
the Understand-tab file picker so users click instead of typing paths.

	GET /api/present/files            → list s.root
	GET /api/present/files?dir=<abs>  → list that dir (must be inside s.root)

Path traversal outside root is rejected. Hidden dirs and node_modules /
vendor / .git are skipped to keep the tree usable.

nodes.Name: methodsWithCFGFor
nodes.DocComment:
v24: methodsWithCFGFor returns the methods of a type that DO have a CFG, so the
flow panel can offer them when a type (which has none) is selected. Each entry
is {id, name} — the UI turns them into clickable links.

nodes.Name: SourceLine
nodes.DocComment: SourceLine is one numbered line of source.

nodes.Name: SourceResponse

nodes.Name: LoadEffects
nodes.DocComment: LoadEffects bulk-loads a symbolID→FuncEffects map (e.g. from Context.Effects).

nodes.Name: LoadAllCFGs
